{{Quote|I don't get why the Heralds want to see everything come to an end." <br /> "You don't think folks should do things just because the "dark serpent Zildrog, the destroyer" says so? You ain't exactly alone in that." <br /> "See, that's it, though. I was taught Zildrog was a teacher. A '''haberdasher''' was present in the [[Old World]] on the<ref name="Zakuul" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Chapter1">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=1}}</ref> of [[Zakuul]] during the [[war against Zakuul]].<ref name="Zakuul" /> In [[3631 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref> the haberdasher and a [[Unidentified street musician (Zakuul)|street musician]] had a conversation about the [[Heralds of Zildrog]]. The musician questioned the Heralds' motives, believing [[Zildrog]] to be a teacher, the haberdasher dismissed it, calling Zildrog a [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] monster in the [[Endless Swamp]] and the tales nonsense before returning to selling a hat to the musician.<ref name="Dialogue" />
